package.description: Organize and de-duplicate every document, scan and PDF, on your own computer.

en-US.description: Organize and de-duplicate every document, scan and PDF, on your own computer.
en-US.longDescription: DocAttic is a local-only desktop app that gathers documents, scans, PDFs and receipts scattered across drives, downloads and exports into one organized, de-duplicated archive, filed by year. Nothing is ever uploaded.
en-US.name: DocAttic
